people to reach the summit of Mount Everest, the world’s highest peak. Their climb
was part of a British expedition led by John Hunt. Despite harsh weather, freezing
temperatures, and thin air, they succeeded through determination and teamwork. Their
achievement was celebrated worldwide, and both climbers became herocs. Their climb
remains an inspiration, proving that courage and perseverance can overcome even the
greatest challenges
